_comment: Host CLI tools the w0m workflow depends on. Unlike npm deps (deps-policy.json) these are installed per-machine, so version checks are ADVISORY. Per tool: `min` (floor the workflow needs), `known_good` (last verified working), `source` (how it updates — tools-upgrade knows `brew` and `gcloud` in-place; others report-only), `auto` (max bump tools-upgrade may auto-apply: patch|minor|major|none), optional `smoke` (a cheap post-upgrade compatibility command, run from the w0m-web dir). `auto:none` = detected + reported but NEVER auto-updated (prod-gating / behavior-sensitive). Checked by project/scripts/tools_check.py (`just tools-check`, `--outdated`) and project/scripts/tools_upgrade.py (`just tools-upgrade`).

ast-grep.note: Structural (AST) search-and-rewrite. ✅ T589: Activated with root `sgconfig.yml`, rules in `project/ast-grep/rules/*.yml` (`w0m-no-env-fallback-chain`, `w0m-no-eval-call-ts`, `w0m-no-bare-except-pass-py`), `scripts/ast_grep_check.py`, and `just ast-grep-check`. 🔑 FIXED 2026-08-05: was `ast-grep-cli` via pip inside pyenv 3.12.9; now brew on both host and guest. ⚠️ Does NOT support .astro, .svelte, .vue or .sql, so it cannot cover serena's .astro blind spot (T166); it handles ts/tsx/js/html/css/json/yaml/python/rust. ⚠️ `ast-grep` exits NON-ZERO on no-match, so an exit-code test reports a supported language as unsupported — check stderr for `is not supported` instead. ⚠️ On Linux `/usr/bin/sg` is newgrp, not ast-grep; always invoke `ast-grep` explicitly.

caddy.note: T595 — reverse-proxy server invoked by `just dev-stack` / `just stop-dev` (`w0m-web/project/dev/Caddyfile`) for local HTTPS subdomain routing (`*.w0m.local`). `required: false` because standard port-based dev (`just dev` / `just dev-cp`) runs without Caddy.

cargo.note: T235 AC1 — the Rust build driver. 🔴 UNDECLARED UNTIL 2026-08-19 while a Rust daemon (`com.zeroclaw.daemon`) ran under launchd and the `mlx` stack declared `runtime: "rust"` — the same load-bearing-but-invisible gap omlx/tart/zeroclaw each had. 🔒 **Floor RAISED 1.85.0 → 1.95.0 on 2026-08-19 (owner: "rize rust version").** It is not a round number: the floor is the **highest requirement declared by Rust code actually present in this estate**, and both ends were measured, not guessed. `_ext/ai-memory` declares `rust-version = "1.95"` AND pins `rust-toolchain.toml` `channel = "1.95"`; `wom7mlx` needs ≥1.85 (`edition = "2024"`). max(1.95, 1.85) = **1.95**. ⚠️ ai-memory is EVALUATED, NOT ADOPTED (T235 AC7 / T234) — the floor tracks code **present and buildable**, so if ai-memory leaves `_ext/`, this may drop back to 1.85.0. Installed default is 1.97.1, so the floor is satisfied with room; `rustup check` confirms 1.97.1 IS current stable. `source: rustup` — these live in ~/.cargo/bin and are managed by `rustup update`, NOT brew. tools-check cannot resolve an upstream version for them (falls through to `latest = None`), so they are floor-checked, never auto-bumped.

cargo-clippy.note: T235 AC1 — the linter. 🔬 DECLARED UNDER ITS REAL BINARY NAME. T235 was filed claiming "clippy MISSING"; it is installed — the binary is `cargo-clippy`, and probing the bare name `clippy` returns nothing. tools-check does `shutil.which(<key>)`, so declaring this as `clippy` would have re-committed the exact error the ticket was corrected for. ⚠️ Version scheme differs: clippy 0.1.N ships with rustc 1.N. Floor **0.1.95**, RAISED with the toolchain 2026-08-19 and MEASURED off the pinned toolchain rather than inferred: `rustup run 1.95 cargo-clippy --version` → `clippy 0.1.95`.

cloudflared.note: T595 — Cloudflare Tunnel daemon invoked by `just db-tunnel` (`cloudflared tunnel --config w0m-api/cloudflared/wom.yml run wom`). `required: false` because commit/push/deploy gates do not open a tunnel (`brew install cloudflared`).

colima.note: T480 / T595 — primary Apple Silicon Virtualization.framework OCI container runtime provider invoked by `scripts/oci_sandbox.py` (`just oci-status`, `just oci-up`, `just db-local-up`). `required: false` because non-container workflows and alternative OCI providers (`docker`, `podman`, `tart`) can run without it (`brew install colima`).

deno.note: GATES the deno-check type hook — a version bump can change type-checking. Bump manually + run deno-check.

docker.note: T164 AC1 — container CLI invoked by `w0m-api/scripts/db_baseline.py` (4 subprocess calls: `docker info`, `docker run -d ... postgres:15`, `docker rm -f`) for ephemeral Postgres 15 baseline verification (`just db-baseline-verify` / `just db-baseline-build`). `required: false` because commit/push gates never spin up containers; `auto: none` so engine upgrades stay deliberate.

gauge.note: T237 AC5 — the spec runner for the estate's 190 Gauge specs (`gauge run specs`, wired through `pnpm test:e2e` / `just e2e` / `just e2e-local`). 🔴 UNDECLARED UNTIL 2026-08-19 while load-bearing for the whole corpus — the same invisible-dependency shape omlx, tart, zeroclaw and the Rust toolchain each had, found the same way: by asking what a gate actually depends on. ⚠️ `auto: none` because a runner upgrade changes how specs execute, and this corpus is already the subject of T237 — bumping the thing under test while its trustworthiness is in question would confound both. `required: false`: nothing in the commit/push path runs specs (that is T237 AC4's job), so a machine without gauge is not broken, just unable to run E2E.

gcloud.note: self-updates via `gcloud components update --quiet` (NOT brew). Versions are rolling, not semver — `auto:major` just means 'auto-update to latest' (the level cap is nominal). Smoke = `gcloud version` runs offline & reports the new version.

git.note: T595 — VCS binary invoked across 200+ command/subprocess sites (`scripts/land.py`, `scripts/estate_search.py`, `w0m-web/project/scripts/agent_tree.py`, `scripts/release.py`). Floor `2.39.0` ensures `git worktree` and `--no-pager` behaviors used by agent trees.

graphify.note: uv tool (`graphifyy`). Install: `uv tool install "graphifyy[mcp,sql]>=0.9.92"`. ✅ T590 (2026-10-31): Upstream `graphify 0.9.30+` (`serve.py` dual-compat for `mcp>=1,<3`, plain-string resource URIs + runtime `on_*` callback detection) lifted the old `0.9.15` `mcp<2` `AnyUrl` ceiling; host is running `0.9.92` (`mcp>=1,<3`). Keep both `[mcp,sql]` extras on every install/upgrade: `[mcp]` provides `graphify-mcp`, and `[sql]` carries `tree-sitter-sql` for `w0m-api/supabase/migrations`. Verify after any upgrade with `just graph-health`.

headroom.note: T456 / T595 (AgDR-0052) — installed via `webomage/tap/headroom` (`brew install webomage/tap/headroom`) built from `github.com/webomage/headroom` `beta` branch (continuously aligned to latest upstream official release `0.39.0` + our open PR tweaks `feat/omlx-proxy-routing` & `feat/audit-host-services` on top, ad-hoc signed with `codesign --force --sign -`). Managed as a Homebrew launchd service on `127.0.0.1:8787` via `just headroom-start` / `just headroom-status` (`scripts/headroom_service.py`).

infisical.note: PROD-GATING, auto:minor — owner decision 2026-09-30: patch AND minor bumps auto-apply IF the smoke (real `infisical run` secret injection) passes; major stays manual. ⚠️ infisical is 0.x, where a minor bump (0.43 to 0.44) is the one that may break something, and the smoke covers `run` (the vast majority of calls) but not the `--projectId` path the deploy chain uses: after any minor bump run `just check-infisical`. A failed smoke holds the bump (known_good is not promoted).

jq.note: required:true on MEASURED usage, not habit (T164): 2 command-position invocations in the canonical justfile — `| jq .` in the workflow-trigger recipe (line ~792) and `jq -r '.gateway.auth.token'` (line ~843). Those recipes break outright without it. ⚠️ `jq --version` prints `jq-1.7.1`, not a bare semver; tools_check's SEMVER search handles that, so do NOT add a version_arg.

mkcert.note: T595 — local CA certificate generator invoked by `just dev-stack` (`mkcert -install`) for local HTTPS subdomain development (`*.w0m.local`). `required: false` because standard port-based dev runs over HTTP.

mypy.note: T188 / T595 (AgDR-0052) — type-checks the Python that implements this estate's gates (`just py-typecheck`, scope in w0m-web/mypy.ini). `required: false` because the gate is scoped to one repo's scripts, not to building or shipping anything. Standardized on `source: brew` (`brew install mypy`) across macOS and Linux per AgDR-0052 to eliminate pyenv shim drift.

node.note: T595 (AgDR-0052) — build-time Node.js runtime standardized on Homebrew (`brew install node` for Latest `26.13.0`, `brew install node@22` for LTS floor `22.23.3`) across macOS and Linux. `min: 22.23.3` enforces at least active LTS; `known_good: 26.13.0` tracks current Latest release.

omlx.note: T184 AC3 / T595 (AgDR-0052) — THE local LLM serving tool on Apple Silicon (`omlx serve` on `:8888`, routed behind Headroom `:8787`). Installed via `webomage/tap/omlx` (`brew install webomage/tap/omlx`) built from `github.com/webomage/omlx` `beta` branch (continuously aligned to latest upstream official release `0.7.3` + our PR `#3743` `fix/menubar-adopt-external-omlx` and Gemma 4 `_safe_fused_mse_decode_kernel` `dim > 256` guard on top, ad-hoc signed with `codesign --force --sign -`).

pnpm.note: T595 — canonical package manager and workspace script runner across all 5 TypeScript repos (`w0m-web`, `w0m-api`, `w0m-cf`, `w0m-ext/extension`, `w0m-skills`), invoked 120+ times in `justfile`, `just/estate.just`, `w0m-api/dagger/pipeline.ts`, and hooks. Floor `10.32.0` matches `deps-policy.json -> runtime.engines.pnpm`; `known_good: 12.16.1` tracks the Homebrew binary on PATH.

podman.note: T480 / T595 — rootless OCI container provider probed and started by `scripts/oci_sandbox.py` (`podman machine inspect`, `podman machine start`) as an alternative to Colima and Docker Desktop. `required: false` because any single healthy OCI provider (`colima`, `docker`, `podman`) satisfies local container sandboxes.

pre-commit.note: T595 — hook runner invoked directly by `just check-guardrails` (`pre-commit run gitleaks --all-files`, `pre-commit run guard-test-admin --all-files`) and `.git/hooks/pre-commit` across the estate.

psql.note: T164 AC1 — PostgreSQL interactive/batch client (`libpq` / `postgresql@18`). Measured 33 command/subprocess invocations across 18 files (40 raw before symlink deduplication): `w0m-api/justfile` (`db-psql`, `db-psql-ssl`, `tracks-report`, `upwork-sync-check`, `db-audit-log`), `w0m-api/scripts/db_baseline.py`, `db_local_migrate.py`, `db_local_seed.py`, `stage2_schema_check.py`, `w0m-web/project/scripts/lexicon_lint.py`, and `w0m-web/apps/web/scripts/snapshot-*.mjs`, plus declared in `.w0m/sdlc.json` (`mcp.servers.supabase`) as the primary CLI fallback when the Supabase MCP server is disconnected. `required: false` because commit/push hooks do not require a local `psql` binary; floor `15.0` matches the estate's Supabase Postgres 15 baseline.

python3.note: T595 (AgDR-0052) — standardized on Homebrew (`brew install python` for Latest `3.15.2`, `brew install python@3.12` for stable `3.12.x` floor) across macOS and Linux. `min: 3.12.0` enforces the active stable floor; `known_good: 3.15.2` tracks current Latest Homebrew Python.

rustc.note: T235 AC1 — the compiler itself. 🔒 **Floor RAISED 1.85.0 → 1.95.0 on 2026-08-19 (owner: "rize rust version").** It is not a round number: the floor is the **highest requirement declared by Rust code actually present in this estate**, and both ends were measured, not guessed. `_ext/ai-memory` declares `rust-version = "1.95"` AND pins `rust-toolchain.toml` `channel = "1.95"`; `w0m-mlx` needs ≥1.85 (`edition = "2024"`). max(1.95, 1.85) = **1.95**. ⚠️ ai-memory is EVALUATED, NOT ADOPTED (T235 AC7 / T234) — the floor tracks code **present and buildable**, so if ai-memory leaves `_ext/`, this may drop back to 1.85.0. Installed default is 1.97.1, so the floor is satisfied with room; `rustup check` confirms 1.97.1 IS current stable. ⚠️ `required: false` deliberately: nothing in the commit/push path compiles Rust today (the `mlx` stack holds build/test at `phase: manual` because the VENDORED mlx-rs/candle trees exit 101). Flip to `required: true` the day a Rust gate joins pre-push — not before, or a Rust-less machine fails a check it cannot cause to fail.

rustfmt.note: T235 AC1 — formatter. This one IS gate-adjacent: the `mlx` stack maps `fmt-check` to `phase: pre-commit`, so rustfmt is the only Rust binary already sitting behind a hook. `source: rustup` — these live in ~/.cargo/bin and are managed by `rustup update`, NOT brew. tools-check cannot resolve an upstream version for them (falls through to `latest = None`), so they are floor-checked, never auto-bumped. 🔒 Floor **1.9.0**, RAISED from 1.8.0 on 2026-08-19 with the toolchain. 🔬 Measured, and the measurement mattered: rustfmt does NOT track the rustc number — `rustup run 1.95 rustfmt --version` is **1.9.0-stable**, the SAME rustfmt the 1.97.1 default ships. Inferring "1.95 → rustfmt 1.5-ish" from the toolchain version would have set a floor that never matches reality.

rustup.note: T235 AC1 / T273 AC1 — the toolchain manager, and the reason the other Rust entries carry `auto: none`: it self-updates via `rustup update`, so wiring them to any package manager would fight it. It is the upgrade path for this whole group and provisions the `wasm32-unknown-unknown` target (`rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown`) required by `w0m-cf/crates/w0m-wasm-utils` (T273).

serena.note: 🔴 DO NOT INSTALL THE `serena` MARKETPLACE PLUGIN. Removed 2026-08-31 (`claude plugin uninstall serena@claude-plugins-official`). It is authored by Oraios — serena's own upstream — and distributed through Anthropic's official marketplace, so it looks like the sanctioned way to get this tool. It is not compatible with governing it. The plugin ships NOTHING but a manifest and one .mcp.json whose entire content launches `uvx --from git+https://github.com/oraios/serena` with NO ref, so it resolves upstream's DEFAULT BRANCH on every start. Its own version is a marketplace commit SHA describing the WRAPPER, so pinning the plugin does not pin serena — there is no configuration that reconciles the two. Installed 2026-08-12 22:19Z; commit 5b02bbef rewrote all three .serena/project.yml files to the `language_servers:` schema at 2026-08-13 05:16 -0500, under seven hours later, and the pinned 1.6.1 was dead from then until 2026-08-31. Keeping both registrations is the one arrangement that cannot work: they fight over the same config file, and the ungoverned one wins silently. `just mcp-health` now catches a repeat the same day. LSP-backed symbol edits + diagnostics over MCP (T166). PyPI package is **serena-agent**, NOT `serena` — `serena` on PyPI is an unrelated project at 0.9.1, so installing it gets you the wrong software. 🔴 PINNED 2026-08-05 (T166 AC1b): the launch in ~/.claude.json was `uvx --from git+https://github.com/oraios/serena`, which re-resolved the DEFAULT BRANCH on every start — the one tool that can rewrite source at symbol granularity had no version, no lockfile and no integrity check, and was running an unreleased **1.6.2.dev0**. min/known_good were literally unenforceable against a moving branch. 🔴 EXTENDED & FORKED 2026-09-20 (T170): Pinned to w0m-maintained fork tag `v1.7.0-w0m.1` (casualuser/serena) adding @astrojs/language-server support (AstroLanguageServer under solidlsp) with upstream PR #2085. The smoke test exercises project loading (`serena project health-check .`) rather than just `--version`, so broken schemas or missing language providers fail organically. ⚠️ Bumping this means editing BOTH this entry and the `args` in ~/.claude.json — the version lives in the MCP launch line, not in a lockfile. ⚠️ Needs a `projects` key in ~/.serena/serena_config.yml or it fails to boot. Installed by Headroom as its default --code-memory backend, not chosen independently.

sshpass.note: T179 AC7 — non-interactive SSH password provider required by `tools/devpod-provider-tart/provider.yaml` (`init` and `command` verbs) for Tart Linux devcontainer transport. `required: false` because DevPod/Tart is a workstation sandbox provider, not a commit/push gate.

supabase.note: PROD-GATING: edge-fn deploy + migrations. A CLI bump changed prod behavior before (2026-07-10), which is WHY it now carries a real smoke rather than staying auto:none — `migration list` against the live ledger exercises the connection + migration-parsing path a bump would break, and is non-mutating. Same posture as infisical: patch auto-applies IF the smoke passes; minor/major stay manual. The pending 2.109.1 -> 2.113.0 is a MINOR, so this policy deliberately does NOT take it — review + deploy smoke by hand.
supabase.smoke: cd ../w0m-api && infisical run --env=beta --silent -- sh -c 'supabase migration list --db-url "$DATABASE_URL" >/dev/null'

tart.note: T184 AC3 — THE VM tool, by the same owner decision 2026-08-08. Underpins the whole sandbox line ([[T179]] DevPod provider, [[T180]] agent sandboxes, [[T181]] GUI workstation VMs), which is ~24 unstarted ACs resting on it. 🔴 Undeclared here until 2026-08-09 for the same reason as `omlx`. `required: false` — no gate invokes it.

terraform.note: T595 (AgDR-0052) — standardized on `source: brew` across macOS and Linux instead of single-language `tfenv`.

uv.note: required:true, and doubly so: 2 command-position uses in the canonical justfile (`uv pip install -r pyproject.toml`, `uv run playwright install chromium`, lines ~538-539) AND it is the declared `source` of graphify — a governed tool whose install instructions are `uv tool install`. It was undeclared while a tool that depends on it was governed. ⚠️ `uv --version` embeds a commit hash after the semver; first-semver parsing gets it right, leave version_arg unset.

warp-cli.note: T595 — Cloudflare WARP client CLI invoked by `just check-warp` (in `_deploy-all-chain` and `deploy-api`). `required: false` because offline gates and standard `just deploy` do not invoke `check-warp`; install via `brew install --cask cloudflare-warp` on machines running `deploy-all` or `deploy-api`.

wasm-pack.note: T273 AC1 — Rust-to-WASM packager for Cloudflare Workers (`wasm32-unknown-unknown`). `required: false` alongside `cargo`/`rustc`/`rustup` so Linux `x86_64` and CI machines without a local Rust toolchain use the deterministic `#![no_std]` WASM binary verifier/emitter (`scripts/wasm_worker_check.py`) without failing host preflight.

worker-build.note: T273 AC1 — Cloudflare `workers-rs` build tool (`wasm32-unknown-unknown` target). `required: false` on multi-OS hosts; `w0m-cf/crates/w0m-wasm-utils` compiles as `#![no_std]` `cdylib` (`550` B raw / `389` B gzip) to avoid pulling the `worker` crate's allocator into the 1 MiB Cloudflare Workers Free tier bundle budget (`AgDR-0044`).

zeroclaw.note: T153 — local AI agent runtime (Rust, 31 MB at ~/.cargo/bin/zeroclaw). 🔴 UNDECLARED HERE UNTIL 2026-08-10: installed since 2026-07-27, the subject of a P1 ticket, and invisible to `tools-check` the whole time — the same gap omlx/tart had on 2026-08-09. ⚠️ PROVENANCE CORRECTION: T153 records it as 'installed via cargo'. It is NOT — `cargo install --list` has no entry and neither .crates.toml nor .crates2.json mentions it, so it was built or dropped into ~/.cargo/bin by hand. 🔴 DO NOT WIRE AUTO-UPDATE TO crates.io: the crate NAMED `zeroclaw` there is 0.1.7 (updated 2026-02-27) while this binary is 0.8.3 — a DIFFERENT package. `cargo install zeroclaw` would replace an agent runtime with an unrelated crate. Resolve by content, never by name — the same rule wom7skills applies to skills. ✅ The real upgrade path is its own subcommand: `zeroclaw update`. `auto: none` DELIBERATELY, and this is the reason: the runtime's config still has allowed_roots = ['/'] with workspace_only = false, and forbidden_paths omits ~/.zeroclaw/.secret_key, ~/.infisical and ~/.claude (T153 AC5, NOT STARTED). Auto-pulling an unreviewed binary weekly into that much filesystem access is a supply-chain decision, not a chore. Widen to auto once T153 has hardened the profile.

openspec.note: Spec-driven change workflow (`@fission-ai/openspec`; the bare `openspec` npm package is a dead placeholder). 🔴 ADDED 2026-08-30 — it was UNGOVERNED until then, with no floor at all, which is the wrong posture for the one tool that WRITES agent surfaces into every repo: it generates 10 skills + 10 workflows per declared tool into .agent/, .claude/, .opencode/ and keeps no memory of `--tools`, regenerating from whatever is on disk. ⚠️ `min` is 1.11.0 while 1.6.0 is what is installed, so this reports DRIFT on purpose. The floor is set to what the estate needs, not to what is running — setting it to 1.6.0 to stay green is the same act as raising a ratchet. Two things land in 1.11.0 that the estate wants: Antigravity moves to the shared `.agents/` root (matching Antigravity's own documented default, where `.agent/` is now only backward-compat), and 1.8.0 added a vendor-neutral `agents` target writing `.agents/skills/` for AGENTS.md-aware assistants. 🔴 UPGRADE IS NOT A NO-OP — measured on a scratch repo 2026-08-30: `update --force` on a 1.6.0 layout COPIES to `.agents/` and LEAVES `.agent/` in place (duplication, not migration, despite the release note), and it detected and generated for `codex` from 'legacy artifacts' though codex was never declared. A fresh `init` on 1.11.0 is clean (`.agents/` only). Plan the upgrade per repo with the leftover `.agent/` removed deliberately, not as a side effect.

_out_of_scope_comment: T164 AC1 — host CLIs probed by `scripts/tool_usage_probe.py` (`just tools-usage`) that have ZERO command-position / subprocess invocations across the estate's justfiles, scripts, and git hooks, and are deliberately excluded from `tools` so the policy governs real workflow dependencies rather than whatever happens to be installed on a workstation.

out_of_scope.ansible: 0 command-position uses across the estate; IaC is managed via Terraform (`w0m-api/cloudflare`, `w0m-api/monitoring`) and Cloudflare Wrangler, with no Ansible playbooks.
out_of_scope.bat: 0 command-position uses; interactive terminal pager/cat replacement, never invoked by scripts, recipes, or git hooks.
out_of_scope.cmake: 0 command-position uses; native C/C++ build generator not invoked directly by any estate recipe (`w0m-mlx` compiles via `cargo`).
out_of_scope.direnv: 0 command-position uses; `.env` and `.envrc` files are prohibited across the estate in favour of `infisical run` process injection (T119 AC2b / T135 §6).
out_of_scope.fd: 0 command-position uses; interactive file finder (`fd = os.open(...)` in Python scripts is a local file-descriptor variable, not a CLI call).
out_of_scope.go: 0 command-position uses; no Go stack or module exists in the estate (`stacks-policy.json` runtimes are `node`, `deno`, `python`, `rust`).
out_of_scope.helm: 0 command-position uses; no Kubernetes/Helm charts exist in the estate (compute runs on Cloudflare Workers/Pages and Supabase).
out_of_scope.java: 0 command-position uses; no JVM stack or tooling exists in the estate.
out_of_scope.kubectl: 0 command-position uses; no Kubernetes cluster or manifest exists in the estate.
out_of_scope.ncdu: 0 command-position uses; interactive disk-usage TUI, never invoked by scripts, recipes, or git hooks.
out_of_scope.pip3: 0 command-position uses; Python package management in estate recipes uses `uv` (`uv pip install`, `uv run`, `uv tool install`), never raw `pip3`.
out_of_scope.redis-cli: 0 command-position uses; no Redis instance or client workflow exists in the estate.
out_of_scope.rg: 0 command-position uses; `just search` (`scripts/estate_search.py`) runs `LC_ALL=C git --no-pager grep` per repo, and agent harnesses bundle their own ripgrep.
out_of_scope.ruff: 0 command-position uses; retired from TS/Rust repos in T135 task 3.1 and not wired into any recipe or hook (`py-typecheck` uses `mypy`).
out_of_scope.sg: 0 command-position uses; `ast-grep` is invoked by its full binary name (`ast-grep scan`) because `/usr/bin/sg` on Linux is `newgrp` (shadow-utils).
out_of_scope.sqlite3: 0 command-position uses; Python scripts use the stdlib `sqlite3` module in-process rather than shelling out to the `sqlite3` CLI.
out_of_scope.tree: 0 command-position uses; interactive directory printer (`graph-tree`, `agent-tree`, `context-tree` are `just` recipe names, and `tree = ...` in Python/TS is a local variable).
out_of_scope.wget: 0 command-position uses; HTTP probes in recipes and hooks use `curl` or Python `urllib.request`.
out_of_scope.yq: 0 command-position uses; YAML/JSON parsing in recipes and scripts uses `jq` or Python `json`/`yaml`.
